title: Solution Trade-Off Rating
description: Rating of every candidate on every in-scope requirement, made without the perspectives' preferences or points.

candidates.description: Identifiers of the candidates being rated.

ratings.description: One entry per candidate and in-scope requirement.

rating.description: How well the candidate meets the requirement, on the scale set in config.yaml.

basis.description: What the rating rests on: a source read in this run, the rater's judgment, or a source known only by title or claim. Only a source eliminates a candidate (decision 14).

source.description: Title of the background item the rating rests on; set when basis is source.
